rationale: Fix-up diff directly resolves CR-001: recentReleaseCount now sets max_length=4, so an oversized digit string is rejected by validate_and_sanitize's normal 400 path before it can reach the DynamicConfig.value DB column. Verified with a new regression test (test_rejects_a_recent_release_count_longer_than_its_max_length, asserting a 400 with 'exceeds its limit' on a 5-digit value) plus the full existing suite for the touched files: 71/71 tests pass, including the prior accepted values ("1", "10", "999") which stay well under the new bound. ruff check is clean on both changed files. No new high-risk issue introduced by the fix-up (a stricter length bound only narrows accepted input).
